notes.title: Regular update in July
notes.content: [p]Due to preparations for the official version, after this update, we will reduce the update frequency and focus on the content of the official version.[/p][p]You can join our Discord, where you can get the latest update information and participate in the game's test server.[/p][p]*Due to the temporary inability to find a good translation method, translations in some languages have been temporarily removed.[/p][p][b]New Additions[/b][/p][p]1. Weapon disable now supports faction disable.[/p][p]2. A new character - "Alpha - 0" - has been added, which appears as a training character in the base.[/p][p]3. Missing translations of "German", "Russian", and "Spanish" in some dialogues have been completed.[/p][p]4. A new "Help" panel has been added: You can see the "?" icon in some UI elements. Click it to view the function introduction.[/p][p]5. A hatred mechanism has been added. Enemies will prioritize locking on the unit that has dealt the most damage to them (hatred will gradually decay by a percentage).[/p][p]6. Perfect dodges can now dodge self - harming projectiles.[/p][p][b]Adjustments[/b][/p][p]1. The "First - Aid Kit" mechanism has been adjusted: The ammunition limit has been increased. Ammunition will no longer be naturally restored. Instead, full ammunition will be restored in each starting area. High - quality first - aid kits will also restore ammunition after killing a target.[/p][p]2. Perfect dodges can now reset the number of jumps.[/p][p]3. The number of weapon disable slots has been changed to 5.[/p][p]4. The UI of the weapon and plugin catalog has been adjusted.[/p][p]5. Weapons in the BOSS room can now be sold.[/p][p]6. The secondary weapons generated by "Shiranui" will now drop as items instead of replacing the current secondary weapon.[/p][p]7. The reward drops in the BOSS room have been improved.[/p][p]8. Weapon \[Flood] adjustment: Attack speed will no longer be reduced during \[Overheat], and \[Flood] will be unable to attack during this period[/p][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][p]1. Missing special effects of some enemies have been fixed.[/p][p]2. Abnormal bullets of some enemies have been fixed.[/p][p]3. Abnormalities of some plugins have been fixed.[/p][p]4. The issue that the area was not cleared after passing through "Endurance Enhancement - Seven" has been fixed. [/p][p][/p][p][/p]

New Content
1.Added 19 new plugins related to "Charging Upgrade".
2.Damage display panel now tracks card data.
3.Seeds can now control the generation of weapons, plugins, and modules.
4.Exclusive weapon affixes now have a "Exclusive" tag (temporary).

Adjustments
1.Adjusted the trigger rate of effects when weapons hit.
2.Reset certain enemies.
3.Optimized some tutorial descriptions.

Bug Fixes
1.Fixed collision issues when entering levels.
2.Fixed abnormal damage reduction behavior.
3.Fixed UI freeze issue.
4.Fixed abnormal outline display on super armor enemies.
5.Fixed save issues with some buffs.

Added
1. Added a new probability compensation mechanism, the probability of triggering "when the weapon hits" for slow weapons such as "Demon Sword" and "Flying Star" is increased, and the probability of triggering "when the weapon hits" for high-speed weapons such as "Torrent" and "Little Assistant" is reduced
2. Marked some plug-ins and weapons with self-injury/lethal effects
3. Added "German" and "Spanish" UI and item translations
Repaired
1. "Bloodletting Therapy" and "Burn" are effective for yourself in some cases
2. The health value of enemies in some areas of the endless level is abnormal
3. The camera and BOSS trigger abnormalities when "Lost One-Teresa" enters
4. Try to fix the BOSS injury-free abnormality
5. Fix the abnormal settlement of the battle challenge level area
6. Fix the endless mode UI out of sync

Fix
1. Abnormal health of "ANNAs" in endless mode
2. Fixed resource abnormality caused by disabled operation
3. Tried to fix NPC loss
4. Fixed backpack problem caused by version update

notes.title: June 2025 Update
notes.content: [p][b]New content[/b][/p][p]1. Main interface update![/p][p]-Now the main interface of the game has been updated, and more characters and interactive elements will be gradually added in the future! I hope everyone likes the current interface.[/p][p][/p][p]2. Adjust the guide description of disabling plug-ins and weapons[/p][p]-The game can disable weapons and plug-ins in the illustration interface. Now the disabled description and operation logic have been optimized to be more intuitive.[/p][p][/p][p]3. Adjust the plug-in illustration interface UI[/p][p]-The arrangement of the plug-in illustration is now adjusted to be consistent with the backpack for easy viewing[/p][p]-The weapon illustration has added a description of the unlocking method, which will be continuously optimized later[/p][p][/p][p]4. Added 8 plug-ins[/p][p]-The effects of the plug-ins will continue to expand, and there are nearly 300 plug-ins at present, so stay tuned[/p][p][/p][p]5. Weakened the health recovery effect of "Lost-Teresa"[/p][p]-Teresa's attack recovery effect on summons has been greatly reduced, and only 1 health value will be restored when hitting multiple targets[/p][p][/p][p]6. Adjust some descriptions[/p][p]-Some plug-in effect descriptions have been changed, which does not affect the original effect[/p][p][/p][p][b]Fixed issues[/b][/p][p]1. NPC loss issue[/p][p]2. Item retention issue when reading files across versions[/p][p]3. Missing air wall in the survival area[/p][p]4. "As expected" takes effect abnormally[/p][p]5. Abnormal background music in the fifth chapter[/p][p]-The BGM of the fifth chapter has been changed, I hope you like it![/p][p][/p][p][b]Others[/b][/p][p]If you encounter a bug, you can use the bug feedback function in the game to quickly send bug information, and we will fix it quickly after receiving it![/p][p]You can also join our QQ group chat or Discord to get game development information![/p][p]Hope everyone has fun ~[/p]

Optimization

Additions
1. A new branch level "Bloody Church" is added (now extended to the end of the level).
2. Four new ordinary enemies are added.

[img]https://imgheybox1.max-c.com/web/bbs/2025/06/23/c5212922a0517f1512106767f40e62e2.png[/img]

notes.title: "Poetry of Blood: Eclipse" enters Early Access today (October 1st)
notes.content:
"Poetry of Blood: Eclipse" is now available! Early bird 10% discount for two weeks!

Starting today, you can dive into the first game developed by ZeroGameStudio, who have been working overtime and pouring their hearts and souls into this project!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43914109/fc4063308e00490eed53ed6af4b7812b917be8ae.png[/img]
A big thank you to all the friends who provided feedback on social media and during the demo phase! 

If you encounter any issues in the EA version, please feel free to bother ZeroGameStudio! Help turn the developers bald and unleash the endless potential of "Poetry of Blood" to become even more fun!

"Poetry of Blood: Eclipse" is the first game in the "Poetry of Blood", priced at $14.99. For the next 14 days, the game will be available at a discount, allowing you to start your BOSS-collecting journey for $13.5!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43914109/efae3a7b8194e4f0a95041bfdcad4297a8ee7a16.gif[/img]
The gameplay experience in the EA version includes:
[list]
[*] [b]Endless Replayability[/b]: A 15-30 minute side-scrolling Rogue-lite action experience with quick restarts & retries.
[*] [b]Randomized stages[/b]: Two clearly themed stages, five BOSSes (with hidden forms), and eight different event rooms for you to challenge.
[*] [b]Growth in and out of battle[/b]: The "Tarot Card" enhancement system and "Synthetic Blood" talent tree allow for over 100 customizable combinations.
[*] [b]Selectable difficulty[/b]: After meeting certain unlock conditions, you can customize the difficulty before entering stages, offering different levels of challenge.
[*] [b]Input devices[/b]: Supports both keyboard/mouse and Xbox controller input, so choose the device you're most comfortable with.
[*] [b]High-Speed Combat[/b]: The protagonist's moves can all be canceled, with complex combo actions and infinite dash range.
[*] [b]BOSS Weapons[/b]: Upon defeating a BOSS, you may obtain the weapon used by the BOSS during combat.
[*] Some weapons have multiple variants, each with different performance and usage conditions.
[*] [b]Favorability and Catgirl Bar[/b]: Use "Synthetic Blood" to stock up the bar with supplies and food, attracting NPCs to visit.
[*] Increasing favorability may lead to discovering hidden stories about the world and the characters!
[/list]

In future updates, ZeroGameStudio will add more weapons, stories, maps, and BOSSes, while continuously improving the Catgirl Bar system, making the world of "Poetry of Blood" more vivid and providing a better gaming experience!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43914109/6024579618b1354ac4773b74658d88e375f6aeb0.png[/img]

Feel free to contact us through social media links! We hope you enjoy an exhilarating adventure in "Poetry of Blood: Eclipse"!
